common_gotchas: When Active is on, logging is continuous and can add overhead during the performance problem being measured.
Trigger Threshold is in milliseconds; choose values that match the target FPS budget.
Enabling too many timing categories can create noisy tables and make root-cause scanning harder.
Perform DAT logs table diagnostics; it does not itself optimize or throttle the project.
key_concepts: Logs performance timing information in a Table DAT format similar to Performance Monitor.
Active and Active Pulse control continuous logging versus one-shot snapshots.
Trigger Mode and Trigger Threshold determine whether logging refreshes on slow frames or dropped frames.
Individual log toggles select cook, export, viewport, movie, CHOP draw, object view, panel, MIDI, graphics, frame length, misc, script, and render timing categories.
